$comment: Generated by tools/colour.mjs from colour.config.json. Never edit by hand.

p.$description: Primitives: the raw palette, generated from colour.config.json. Private; no component reads them.

base.$description: Private. Base colours (cool): black, white and the greys between, for text, surfaces and outlines

accent.$description: Private. The accent ramp, reusing brand colour 1: actions, links, focus and selection

info.$description: Private. Info status ramp, read only by color.status.info.*

success.$description: Private. Success status ramp, read only by color.status.success.*

warning.$description: Private. Warning status ramp, read only by color.status.warning.*

danger.$description: Private. Danger status ramp, read only by color.status.danger.*

alpha.$description: Private. Translucent layers: hover, press, selection and shadows

base-6.$description: Base at 6%: hover layer on light surfaces

base-12.$description: Base at 12%: pressed layer on light surfaces

white-8.$description: White at 8%: hover layer on dark surfaces

white-14.$description: White at 14%: pressed layer on dark surfaces

brand.$description: Identity marks only (logos, illustration, a brand band); never actions or status (those read the accent roles). The same in every context.

on-1.$description: Text and marks on brand colour 1
